images.title: Stretch one band: square to rhombus
images.purpose: Before and after: two 4 cm bands crossing at right angles at their midpoints make a square; stretching one band to 8 cm makes a rhombus.
images.composition: Plain white background, the main object large and centred with wide empty margins, no scenery, no characters, no extra decoration. Two panels side by side with plenty of space between them: on the left the square, on the right the rhombus, each with its two crossing bands.
images.exact_structure: Left panel: a teal (#0072B2) band, 4 units long, horizontal, and an amber (#E69F00) band, 4 units long, vertical, crossing at their midpoints at right angles, with a small filled reddish purple (#CC79A7) square right angle mark at the crossing. Their four end points are joined by thin dark lines into a square standing on a corner. Label 4 cm beside the teal band, 4 cm beside the amber band, and the word square under the panel. Right panel: the same teal band, still 4 units long, horizontal, and the amber band now 8 units long, vertical, still crossing at their midpoints at right angles with the same reddish purple right angle mark. The four end points are joined by thin dark lines into a tall rhombus. Label 4 cm beside the teal band, 8 cm beside the amber band, and the word rhombus under the panel. Both panels use the same scale. Nothing else in the frame.
rejection: any count of objects, cells, ticks or rows that differs from the numbers stated in the spec
any text beyond the listed visible text, or any listed text misspelled or altered
any board name, publisher name, book title, page number or curriculum branding anywhere in the frame
a hyphen used in place of a minus sign on any labelled number
images.takeaway: Diagonals that bisect each other at 90° make a rhombus, and a square only when they are also equal.
images.description: Before and after: two 4 cm bands crossing at right angles at their midpoints make a square; stretching one band to 8 cm makes a rhombus.
images.context: Extended band 2 + 4 + 2 = 8 cm, midpoint unchanged; diagonals 4 cm and 8 cm, so a rhombus, not a square.

image_decisions.why: Seeing the same crossing before and after stretching one band separates the square from the rhombus.
